claim_manifest.claim_text: Fusion contains 8,590 materialized parts, 467,411 contact points, and 35,210 pooled inaccessible points (7.5 percent).
The retained-cohort audit mapped and read all 8,590 Fusion and 300 Thingi10K raw meshes, while reporting rather than suppressing non-watertight and non-manifold topology.
The signed label audit reports 0.63 percent robust mismatch and 97.28 percent 48-versus-96 agreement.
Contact-count and true-area correlations with inaccessible fraction are weak: 0.264 and 0.124 over all Fusion parts.
Ray-visible but finite-tool-inaccessible contacts account for 4.86 percent on Fusion and 29.25 percent on procedural data.
Five repeated model-level holdouts yield equal-part inaccessible-class F1 0.793±0.022 and IoU 0.737±0.025; the mean per-repeat median F1 is 0.948±0.029 and the mean per-repeat F1 IQR is 0.313±0.032.

On the fixed canonical holdout, the shape-conditioned surrogate reaches point-pooled F1 0.920 versus 0.676 for zero-radius ray visibility and 0.853 for the 16-global-direction coarse finite-tool proxy.
The independent model-level paired difference over the ray baseline is 0.463 with 95 percent CI [0.375, 0.553].
Within the controlled ablation, no-shape, local, lite, and pooled F1 values are 0.434, 0.857, 0.907, and 0.818.

A captured historical fixed-subset cross-domain evaluation gives Fusion F1 0.885±0.010 and Thingi10K F1 0.889±0.006, with no observed drop on that subset; it was not rerun in the current evidence refresh.

The refreshed directional field reaches per-direction F1 0.901±0.004, direction-set IoU 0.868, Top-1 hit 0.959, and AND-reduced point F1 0.817; all 500 models use refined labels and a deterministic audit reports eligible denominators and non-neural ranking baselines.
claim_manifest.manuscript_locator: Abstract and Results 5.4, Figure 9 and Table 6

claim_manifest.claim_text: The current implementation shows an approximately 112-fold amortized query-time magnitude difference.
Five-seed failure rates are highest for contacts with only one to five viable directions.
